conceptZh: 一台迷你發條機器人拖著比自己大兩倍的紅色愛心鼓，走到一艘載著三顆熟睡紅豆玩具的紅色小船旁，屏住呼吸「咚」地敲一下。像一聲心跳，三顆豆子被彈出船外：一顆落在左下，兩顆彈到上方停住，正好是三個點；小船留在原地變成臥鉤，組成完整的「心」。
object: a cherry-red cushion boat shaped exactly like the curved hook stroke, holding three sleeping red bean toys, plus a tiny wind-up toy robot dragging a giant red heart-shaped drum
morph: one soft heartbeat-style drum thump bounces the three beans out of the boat: the first plops low at the left and the other two hang in the air then settle high above the center and upper right as the three dots, while the boat smooths into the curved hook stroke, completing 心
creativeAngle: 不再沿用愛心裂開的舊概念，改以「尺寸落差＋一聲心跳」做笑點：小機器人拖著超大愛心鼓、舉槌停頓再敲，豆子嚇得彈起停在半空，落點恰好是三個點，船身直接保留成臥鉤，物件與筆畫一一對應。鼓敲完就滾出畫面、機器人追出去，保證最後三秒畫面只剩乾淨的「心」。
promptEn:
8-second animated literacy clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 心 (heart). Style: soft stop-motion-flavored 3D toy animation with felt and vinyl textures, rounded shapes, warm even daylight, no dark grading, no neon, no pure-white blowouts. Background: a plain pale butter-cream field with no other text, props or clutter.

0.0–1.5s: Centered on screen sits a plump cherry-red cushion boat shaped exactly like the curved hook stroke of 心: a wide shallow bowl curve that begins at the left, sweeps down and across to the right, and curls up into a short hook at its right end. Three round red bean toys snooze inside it, gently rising and falling, while the boat rocks softly.

1.5–3.0s: A tiny silver wind-up toy robot waddles in from the left, dragging a giant red heart-shaped drum twice its own size, and props it just beyond the boat's left tip. The robot lifts a soft padded mallet high above its head, freezes for a comic beat, eye-lights widening. The off-screen voice says the first "心" at about 1.6s.

3.0–4.5s: One soft, padded drum thump, like a single heartbeat. The boat bounces once and the beans pop out: the first bean hops out to the left and plops down low at the left, just above the boat's left tip; a beat later the other two shoot straight up, hang in the air for a surprised half-second with tiny wobbles, then settle high above the boat, one over its center and one at the upper right above the hook. The drum rebounds off the robot and rolls out of frame to the right, and the robot scurries after it, leaving the frame clean. The voice says the second "心" at about 3.6s.

4.5–5.0s: Each bean squashes into a plump teardrop dot stroke and the boat smooths into a clean curved hook stroke, all the same saturated cherry red, forming the complete, correctly proportioned 心: one dot low at the left, the curved hook sweeping across the bottom and rising into its hook at the right, and two dots high above the center and the upper right. The glyph is centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with even margins.

5.0–8.0s: Hold the finished 心 perfectly still and clear for the full 3 seconds with nothing else on screen. At about 5.5s the voice says "開心".

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin speaks exactly "心、心、開心" and nothing more, unhurried, with a short pause between each utterance. Soft toy sound effects only: one padded thump, two gentle boings, tiny plops; any background music stays quiet beneath the voice. No on-screen presenter, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no flashing effects.

conceptZh: 科學家老鼠研究像心臟般規律搏動的「心」，卻忙著用雙手和尾巴堵住冒泡的燒杯。下一次搏動讓泡沫噗地變成牠的巨大假髮；牠放手後，氣泡恢復平穩，完整字形清楚留下。
object: A solid crimson 心 glyph connected to one compact laboratory base with three integrated bubbling beaker chambers.
morph: Begin with the correctly formed glyph. Its rigid silhouette moves gently forward and back like a heartbeat, driving bubbles through the laboratory base. After the foam gag, the base lowers away and the unchanged glyph remains still.
creativeAngle: 改用完整字形帶動心跳實驗，不拆愛心、不讓零件拼字。老鼠用雙手加尾巴堵三個杯口，反被泡沫戴上巨大假髮；笑點集中在角色反應，四筆結構全程保持正確。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D animated literacy clip featuring the Traditional Chinese glyph 心. Against a light warm apricot background, keep a saturated crimson 心 centered, uncropped, and approximately 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Use a correctly formed Traditional Chinese typeface silhouette: four clearly separated strokes, including the authentic curved hook and three distinct dot strokes. Preserve this exact silhouette throughout.

The original lead is a proudly meticulous cartoon laboratory mouse with oversized round spectacles, lavender ears, and a tiny mint laboratory coat. Its single laboratory apparatus has three transparent beaker chambers permanently integrated into a compact base below the glyph. The chambers contain softly bubbling peach liquid; their internal channels are hidden. Give everything a simple rounded animated appearance, with bright, even lighting and restrained surface detail.

At the opening, the mouse stands beside the apparatus, proudly watching 心 make a gentle forward-and-back movement as one rigid shape, like a heartbeat. Each beat pumps a small bubble into each chamber. At 0.4 seconds, a warm, friendly off-screen voice says “心”. The mouse notices the rising bubbles and officiously tries to stop them: one paw covers the first chamber, the other covers the second, and its tail hurriedly plugs the third. By 1.8 seconds, it holds this ridiculous balancing pose, looking thoroughly pleased with its solution.

After a brief anticipation pause, the next gentle heartbeat at 2.3 seconds sends a soft puff of foam around all three plugs. The foam gathers directly onto the mouse’s head as an absurdly enormous curly wig. Its spectacles slip slightly; it looks upward, then gives a slow, astonished blink. Keep the foam beside and below the glyph, leaving all four strokes readable. The voice says the second “心” at 3.0 seconds. The mouse releases all three openings, and the bubbling immediately becomes calm. It straightens its spectacles with renewed dignity; the foam wig quietly collapses into one tiny bubble and pops.

From 3.7 to 4.6 seconds, the mouse gives a satisfied nod and rides the laboratory base smoothly downward out of view. The glyph’s heartbeat motion settles completely without changing any stroke. From 4.6 through 8.0 seconds, hold only the finished 心 perfectly still, centered and unobstructed. During this clear hold, at approximately 5.4 seconds, the voice says “心臟”.

The complete spoken line is exactly “心、心、心臟”, delivered naturally in clear Taiwanese Mandarin with short pauses and no additional speech. The word is audio only. Use quiet bubbling, one soft foam puff, and a tiny bubble pop beneath the narration; no music is needed. The single target glyph 心 is the only on-screen text. Keep the final composition clean, with no subtitles, labels, logos, watermark, or flashing effects.
